description: This file defines the JavaStackFrameSnapshot class, representing a snapshot of a Java or JNI stack frame within a thread, including details such as package name, class name, method name, source file, line number, language type, and associated lock snapshots.

classes.name: JavaStackFrameSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of a Java or JNI stack frame, including frame details and associated locks, with methods for cloning.
